name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Key Lime Pie
description:
Tart, creamy, and dessert-smooth. The Cheech & Chong Key Lime Pie D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Key Lime Pie nails the classic: zesty, tangy lime up front, layered with sweet whipped cream and a buttery graham-crust finish. It's a bright-meets-indulgent profile made for anyone who likes their sessions citrusy, sweet, and full of flavor.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Key Lime Pie flavor — zesty lime with sweet cream and a buttery crust finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Bright flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Key Lime Pie is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
